description.value: Cycles West is a family-owned bicycle shop in Victoria, BC, operating since 2006, offering new and used bike sales alongside full mechanical service for all styles of bikes from commuters to gravel and e-bikes. With Shimano-certified staff and decades of combined experience, the shop caters to a wide range of cyclists including those preparing for bikepacking adventures and touring rides. Custom builds are also available, and the shop participates in a tire stewardship recycling program.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact details. The site confirms bike repair services for all styles including e-bikes (with a detailed e-bike policy), mentions bikepacking/touring gear, and explicitly invites customers to bring in bikes for free assessments, supporting walk-in and same-day urgent repair claims. No evidence found for amenities such as pump, washrooms, rentals, DIY stand, or charging.
concerns: OSM stores the unit as a separate addr:unit=A tag, resulting in the address appearing as '100 Burnside Road West' in the OSM record, while the website consistently uses '100A Burnside Rd. West'. Minor formatting discrepancy only; the physical address is the same.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established full-service bike shop in Victoria with confirmed repairs, touring/gravel gear, e-bike service, and a welcoming walk-in culture — a clear asset for touring cyclists passing through or based in Victoria.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: Repair booking form includes a 'Need done ASAP!' priority option; website states 'We work hard to get you back on your bike ASAP, and can always provide you with a time estimate to complete the job.'

Touring parts stocked.detail: Website explicitly lists Touring and Gravel among bike categories served, and mentions carrying gear to 'prep for that bikepacking trip'; also does custom builds

E-bike service.detail: Detailed E-Bike Repair Policy on website: services mechanical components (brakes, tires, drivetrain, etc.) on two-wheeled e-bikes under 75 lbs with mid-drive or rear-hub motors; does NOT service motors, batteries, displays, wiring, or electrical components unless the bike was purchased through their shop

wow_evidence: family-owned bicycle shop operating since 2006 ... bikepacking/touring gear ... Shimano-certified staff
